description:
The few guards that address the most rules for these AI features and markets, ranked: each guard in one sentence
(a guard is a change to make in the application's code or settings, such as a notice, a check or a human review
step), how many rules it addresses by lane, where binding law on it applies, and up to three example rule ids.

When to use: someone asks what to build first, or how to cover several markets at once. Ranked by the markets with
binding law in force, then law coming, then rules addressed. Leave out features or markets to rank over all of
them. Returns at most 5 guards; pass an example rule_id to explain_rule for detail.
Limits: informational data, not legal advice.

features.description: The AI feature's integration patterns, any of: chat, rag, agentic, decision_pipeline (a model output that decides about a person), content_generation, classification, recommendation, embeddings. Omit it for every pattern.
features.title: Features

jurisdictions.description: Markets to cover, as codes: EU, a country code (GB, CN, KR, JP, BR, SG) or a US state as US-XX (US-CA, US-CO, US-NY); US matches every state. Omit it for every market.
jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 5 (default 5); `total` in the answer says how many matched.
limit.title: Limit
